standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of Mor
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the etale reduction on B possible.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale cover of Mor
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the etale reduction on X possible.

standard_prerequisites.name: Glueing spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Assembles the open covering into an algebraic space.

core_obligations: Reduce B to finite free affine by an etale surjective cover, using base-change compatibility of Mor.
Reduce X to a disjoint union of affines by the etale-covering lemma.
Cover Mor_B(Z, X) by the open subspaces F_E for finite E and handle the set-theoretic size issue of the coproduct (footnote).
proof_roadmap: Two successive etale reductions on B and X, then an open covering by the F_E with the quasi-compactness argument for surjectivity of the covering; size bookkeeping is in the footnote.
difficulty_reason: Three substantial stages (two reductions + open-covering assembly), each with its own argument.
